component: Proposal-independent seeded sampling for typed point-mass drafts
modifications: For typed deterministic point-mass proposals, sample each reachable target law once and accept a proposal only when that target sample equals it
Stop at the first mismatch; unvisited target rows remain provisional and consume no RNG draws
Retain general rejection/residual verification for stochastic proposal laws
Bind the new verifier law into external route/cache identity so prior RNG snapshots cannot silently cross the change

public_validation.scope: Source integration and focused synthetic CPU regressions; no model qualification or performance claim.
public_validation.evidence: Focused synthetic test modules distributed with this implementation; private campaign evidence is not distributed.
